description: Source of 68 Able2Shell exploitation attempts against Previdian's N-central decoy from 9 November, including XXE and /etc/passwd reads, and host of the a.dtd and svc.xml payload files.
notes: Also reported by Lupovis (via Beazley Security) for SOAP requests to the vulnerable endpoints; ASN: AS214902 PFWeb Solutions (VPS hosting), not in Spamhaus DROP

description: Source of 4EverAble2Shell exploitation against live N-central servers on 12 November, and of earlier probing seen by Previdian. huntback saw this address probe its decoys, then run the full chain (code execution as the nable user, root through nable_wrapper.pl, then curl of jup.sh to install an XMRig miner). It also hosts the installer on TCP 8080 and opens a TCP callback on ports 19202 to 19418. By 12:50 UTC, 21 production N-central servers, 19 already on 2026.4 HF2, were listed as nc_ rigs on the operator's mining pool.
notes: Previdian via The Hacker News; huntback Research and BleepingComputer confirmed live miner installs from this address on 12 November. ASN: AS152565 Joy Services (VPS hosting, Mumbai), not a major shared cloud. Also listed by N-able in its own 13 November indicators of compromise.
